look_here_first: Very spiny annual with deeply divided leaves, bright yellow flowers, and one conspicuously long curved anther.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays-local in repaired Master Plant Pool and present in the user's iNaturalist-derived source set.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Installed for active visual learning; broader exact-county reconciliation deferred.

morphology_keys.family_pattern: Solanaceae/Solanum: alternate leaves, 5-parted rotate or star-shaped corollas, poricidal anthers, and berry fruits; prickles and stellate hairs occur in many species.
best_field_traits: fruit enclosed by prickly accrescent calyx
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Yellow flowers plus extreme prickliness make it unmistakable in this batch. The unequal anthers are an especially useful close-up trait.
